admitCard.where: The CRP PO/MT section of ibps.in, signed in with your registration number and date of birth or password. No hard copy is posted.
admitCard.when: Preliminary exam call letters a couple of weeks before the exam (CRP PO/MT-XVI: from 14 August 2026 for exams on 22 and 23 August 2026). Mains call letters and the information handout follow for qualified candidates (handout from 24 September 2026 for the 4 October 2026 mains).
steps: Open ibps.in and go to the CRP PO/MT link for the current cycle.
Open the call letter download link and sign in with your registration number and date of birth or password.
Download the call letter and check your name, photo, roll number, exam date, shift, reporting time and centre address against your application.
Print it clearly. If any detail is wrong, write to the IBPS helpdesk at once, before exam day.
After the prelims result, download the mains call letter and the information handout the same way, and later the interview call letter for shortlisted candidates.
carry: A printed call letter (a screenshot is not accepted)
One original photo ID as named in the call letter instructions, such as Aadhaar, PAN, passport, driving licence or voter ID
A passport-size photograph, if the call letter asks for one
Only what the call letter allows. Phones, watches and calculators are not allowed inside
admitCard.note: Your exact exam date, shift and city appear on the call letter itself. The interview call letter's date, venue and time allotted cannot normally be changed.

answerKey.summary: IBPS does not publish question papers or official answer keys for the PO exam and runs no objection window. The result and scorecard are your first official feedback.
steps: Treat coaching-site keys as a rough estimate only, since scores are normalised across shifts (equi-percentile method) and the marking is weighted.
Wait for the prelims and mains results on ibps.in rather than chasing keys.
Download your scorecard from the result link when it opens and save a copy.
answerKey.note: This is IBPS practice across the PO cycle, not an omission of the current notice: no response sheet, no provisional key and no challenge process is offered at any stage.

result.summary: Results are published as PDF lists on ibps.in, followed by a scorecard with the 'Process for Arriving at Scores' note. Prelims marks are never counted in the final merit.

stages.what: A qualifying screen. Candidates who clear the sectional cut-offs and land inside the shortlist (a number fixed by IBPS per category against vacancies) move to the mains. CRP-XVI prelims result: 29 September 2026.

Shortlist for the Common Interview at a ratio decided by IBPS against the vacancies (expected November 2026 for CRP-XVI). The mains score carries 80% weight in the final combined score, so this list decides who is really in the race.

Common Interview out of 100 marks, conducted by the participating banks with a nodal bank coordinating. Minimum qualifying marks are 40% (35% for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates). Carry originals: degree certificates and mark-sheets, category certificate in the central format, EWS certificate where claimed, and photo ID.

Allotment to the 11 participating banks on merit-cum-vacancy, honouring reservation norms and your preference exercise (expected January 2027 for CRP-XVI). Allotment is provisional and valid for one year. Candidates just below the main list may be allotted from the reserve list in later rounds.

result.scorecard: IBPS publishes scores with the 'Process for Arriving at Scores' note on ibps.in after each result stage. Scorecards stay available for a limited window, so download and save yours.
